analysis:
MARKET REGIME: MIXED — SPY fractionally below its SMA50 but 20-day slope still positive. No clear directional conviction; sideways chop is the most likely near-term path. This is not a high-probability entry environment.

PORTFOLIO HEALTH CHECK — CRITICAL:
The 0% win rate across 13 closed trades with a Sortino of -13.97 is the loudest signal in this review. Every closed trade has been a stop-out. This is not bad luck; it is evidence that entries have been poorly timed relative to trend confirmation. The correct response is to raise the bar dramatically, not to add trades.

POSITION-BY-POSITION REVIEW:
• AMP (-8.47%, $9,515): CONCERN. AMP does NOT appear on today's screened candidate list, which means its trend/quality has degraded enough to fail the filter. At -8.47% from entry, the position is approaching stop territory. Thesis is weakening. If a stop was placed ~15% below entry (~$465), it has not yet triggered, but the position should be watched daily. If fundamental thesis cannot be clearly restated, this is a candidate for manual exit on any bounce.
• FOXA (+0.79%, $11,804): Essentially flat. Not on screened list either. Holding is acceptable but conviction is low; any deterioration warrants exit.
• IT (+11.28%, $9,446): HOLD. Gartner is working. Quality compounder in a modest uptrend. No action needed.
• NVDA (-0.54%, $15,201): Flat and in a MIXED/SIDEWAYS extending pattern, -4% below SMA50. Thesis (AI infrastructure) remains intact long-term. Size is reasonable. Hold, but do not add here — the trend has not confirmed.
• ULTA (+6.32%, $21,939): HOLD. Largest position and working. No action needed.

NEW TRADE CANDIDATES: We are already at 5 positions — the maximum for this concentrated strategy. Available headroom is $22,797 but adding a 6th name would violate concentration discipline. Beyond the mechanical constraint, the 0% win rate is a hard behavioral signal: the edge claimed by new entries has not materialized. Several candidates are technically appealing (ADBE at 31% of range with fwd P/E ~8.9 is interesting on valuation; ADSK basing in uptrend; TEL near SMA50) but none clears the bar of 'genuinely asymmetric + capacity to size properly' when we are already fully allocated and have zero evidence of timing edge. Earnings landmines in the next 8-16 days on TEL, EXE, TYL, ORLY, SPGI add event risk. Forcing a 6th position into a MIXED market with a 0% win rate would be precisely the kind of error this strategy is designed to avoid. RECOMMENDATION: Zero new trades. Hold winners (IT, ULTA), monitor AMP closely for thesis-break exit, and let cash work defensively. A quiet book is a success, not a failure.
